svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 16 mm off 30 x 10 mm flat bar: 30 wide, 16 tall, 10 deep.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 4.5 mm holes through the 10 mm depth, 8 mm in from each end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (14 mm apart), 10 mm up from the bottom face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Counterbore both from the front face 8 mm across, 5 mm deep, so

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the M4 x 16 socket cap screw heads sit below the face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Break the front edges by 1 mm so it finds the slot easily.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: back face flat on the key-end flange, bottom 4 mm above the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: flange's bottom edge, centre at the grade position:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: C5 43 mm toward the front, C25 on the centre line,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Leave it bare aluminium; stamp the grade on its top face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: 3 mm clear of the frame slot all round when seated.
